body.objective: Turn the sector-restricted anomaly calculation into the first exact quantum disposition of the D-Cartan identity on each declared zero-charge or clock sector.
body.stop_condition: Import the terminal sector-restriction certificate and the certified classical identities [Q,iota_D]=L_D (or the exact Berger K_Berger replacement where applicable).  Compute the induced ghost-number-one Cartan defect A_D on the complete declared restricted cochain carrier, including measure and zero-mode contributions available at the dependency boundary.  Classify it as zero, BRST-exact with an explicit admissible counterterm/operator correction, nontrivial with an explicit cohomology witness, or SHORTFALL with a typed missing-input request.  Keep raw D and K_Berger distinct and produce exact producer/independent-verifier receipts.
body.forbid: no parity-only cyclic convention; no local Euclidean anomaly coefficient used as a Lorentzian operator identity without an imported bridge; no raw-D/K_Berger identification; no global anomaly, Hadamard, particle, positivity or unitarity promotion
activates: a corrected quantum Cartan contraction on any sector with exact removable defect
or a scoped no-go for the D quotient on any sector with a nontrivial defect
body.resource_hint: QUANTUM CONTINGENT RUNWAY.  Pull only after the restriction theorem lands; classify the exact defect rather than assuming anomaly freedom or failure.
notes: This is the quantum version of the programme's central D-quotient question.
A local exactness witness must be admissible in the same field content and sector; the obstructed minimal compensator actions are not implicit counterterms.
